name: erp_sales_orders_list
description: List sales order transactions, optionally filtered by status or customer entity (GET /services/rest/record/v1/salesOrder)

status.description: Order status filter: pendingApproval, pendingFulfillment, billed or cancelled.

entity.description: Customer (entity) internal id the order is billed to, e.g. customer_006.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default 30).
